title: Prompt-Settlement Discount on the Early-Termination Charge — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Terms.** A creditor client settling the fees it owes on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements after giving termination notice receives a prompt-settlement discount taken off the early-termination charge booked on the agreement. It is 10 percent of that charge where the payment is made no more than 10 calendar days after the date the termination notice was received, 5 percent where it is made more than 10 but no more than 30 calendar days after it, and nothing later.

**Dates.** The date the termination notice was received is the request date of the client's termination notice service request. The days run from that date to the day the payment is made, the notice date not counted and the payment day counted.

**Base.** The discount is a percentage of the early-termination charge entries booked on the agreement, not of the whole fees owed.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the agreement's fees owed itself; every amount taken off the payment is taken off that same fees owed, the payment is never less than zero, and it is rounded to the cent once at the end. The discount is cleared by credit on the closing statement.

## Discount by days since the notice was received

| Days from the notice received date to the payment | Discount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 10 | 10 percent of the early-termination charge |
| 11 to 30 | 5 percent of the early-termination charge |
| 31 or more | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

Termination notice received on 2026-03-02; early-termination charge booked on the agreement 1500.00 USD.

- Payment on 2026-03-12, 10 days after: discount 150.00 USD.
- Payment on 2026-03-13, 11 days after: discount 75.00 USD.
- Payment on 2026-04-01, 30 days after: discount 75.00 USD.
- Payment on 2026-04-02, 31 days after: no discount.
